summary: The change has one correctness defect and one missing regression test.

findings.title: Cancellation can publish a stale success result
findings.description: The completion path can commit success after cancellation wins the lifecycle race.
findings.recommendation: Gate result commit on the authoritative task lifecycle revision and add a cancellation race test.

findings.title: No regression test covers duplicate tool-call retry
findings.description: The adapter has no test proving that transport retry returns the original review identity.
findings.recommendation: Add a same-tool-call retry test and assert one Reviewer Run and one result artifact.
